Matthew Henry was an English Presbyterian minister.
His Exposition of the Old and New Testaments appeared in the early 1700s, and other ministers completed it from his notes after his death in 1714.
It reflects the historical context of his time and his own theological views.
Versely uses Matthew Henry\'s Concise Commentary on the Whole Bible, a later abridgment of that work, and shows this edition complete, with nothing left out.
